Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Smitherman
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 78 as introduced would delay, for four years, implementation of the 3rd grade retention requirements under the Alabama Literacy Act until the 2025-2026 school year. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy
